summary: Clearway arterial kerb beside a shopping centre, no parked cars, no pull-off.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked at kerb
Footpath and verge trees, no room off lane

drivers.seclusion: Shops and customer car park on the east side; apartments 25-30 m across the road; fully in view of traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a busy through road with a footpath behind it; no parking lane and no parked cars along it.
drivers.traffic: Constant arterial traffic near a signalised junction and ramps.
drivers.convention: Clearway C signs apply Mon-Sat 7am-7pm; no one parks on this kerb.

flags: Steep: 4.8% mean (49% max is DEM noise at the far end)
sun_shade: Street trees on the east verge shade the kerb in the morning.
